title: Construct a paid pivoted BIT fallback with at most 1+12r children
body:
## Summary

Scoped construction proof with finite corroboration. A new paid-pivot BIT fallback implements every split rank-r projector over every odd prime-power ring, including arbitrary dirty data and diagonal ancestor weights. No new kappa or supplier admission is claimed.

```text
pivot the rank-r cross block with paid swaps
execute the ordered-ADD adapter
execute one weighted reversed rf-child
execute the inverse adapter
```

The complete child bill is one width-rf child, at most 4r width-f children and at most 8r width-floor(f/2) children. Half-width calls are omitted for f=1. At m=64,r<=42 there are at most 505 children, with linear width moment at most 9rf. The new largest child has width rf, so this is not an equal-tariff runtime comparison with the retained 49,911-child fallback envelope. The adapters also have exactly f[4r(m-1)-2r(r-1)+2m^2] scalar ordered-ADD slots, including zero coefficients, or 15,332f slots at rank 42.

This extends Cinna Davis's #4100 block identity: paid unit pivoting supplies invertible L,R0 with LPC R0=EDC for every split projector. Triangularity is unnecessary in the block identity. The old generic fallback eliminates the full 2m-coordinate involution; this construction retains one rank-r child. The extra-child bound is attained by the declared compiler on suffix projectors, without claiming a universal minimum.

Only `research/bit-pivoted-fallback/` changes. Base: `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7. Publication commit: `27f1ce44126cb3a841756834649f556de0ce00e9`.

## Evidence and reproduction

Before: arbitrary bad packets use the retained full-matrix fallback. After: a separate compiler supplies the pivoted rank-r construction with all swaps and inverse adapters charged.

Local exact checks enumerate 417,575 matrix candidates and all 1,134 nontrivial idempotents in five small-ring domains. They test 1,263 plans, including 1,074 needing paid pivots, on 11,490 basis/dirty vectors and 11,490 involution roundtrips against a separate direct endpoint oracle. All 128 low/high itinerary comparisons pass. Sixteen literal 64-coordinate fixtures cover all eight retained paid ranks at f=1 and f=3, including rank 42 and the attained 12r extra-child count. Four semantic and four invalid-input controls pass.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-pivoted-fallback
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/bit-pivoted-fallback/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/bit-pivoted-fallback/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-pivoted-fallback --check-source-history
```

All pass locally on CPython 3.12.15. Direct normal and optimized checks take 2.52 s and 2.39 s, below their 120-second limits; these are check durations. Markers: `PASS_BIT_PIVOTED_FALLBACK`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The preflight authenticates all 10 package/input files and source history. The verifier generates its report with all package/input hashes; no receipt is handwritten.

The official committed export passes integrity checking. Both direct modes pass without Git in 2.57 s and 2.61 s, with all 11 exported files unchanged. Altering the declared normal-form input is rejected by its source hash before the scientific replay.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal result rests on the written local construction proof, with no independent human or formal proof-kernel review. The code enforces m<=64, f<=8 and modulus bit length<=4096; the written construction has no such upper limits. Executed rings are the listed prime powers. A completed weighted-child oracle and ordered ADDs are explicit premises. The local proof is not a physical supplier or finite-tape implementation.

Physical coefficient preparation, ratio-weight descriptors, routing, fresh-row divisibility, high-packet scans, storage, parking and restoration at the actual caller remain open. No selected cold replay, global recurrence retuning, all-size compiler admission or complete multiplication theorem was run or claimed. Production inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Open next questions

1. Install one complete m=64 rank-42 physical packet with odd f, frozen ancestors and explicit ratio-weight descriptors; prove its compiler, stock and restoration bill.
2. Compare a pivot policy preferring an already positioned unit with the suffix fixtures. The current count is sharp for this compiler, not for all algorithms.

## Related open work

- #4215 proves/checks the good-packet normal-form identity and asks about fallback costs. This uses that identity as a predecessor and constructs a different fallback. Its finite audit corpus and this new-program corpus differ, so no shared aggregate count is asserted.
- #4227 counts exact extreme-rank unpivoted good headers. This is a local construction for every projector, with no overlapping density number to compare.
- #4228 gives the all-rank unpivoted good-header law and a fallback-pricing handoff. This does not change or recheck its density law; no overlapping density number is asserted.
- #4237 sharpens the count for the unchanged full-matrix fallback. Both quote the source envelope 49,911 = 3*16,637, which agrees arithmetically. This new algorithm instead retains a width-rf child, so their complete child histograms differ; its new maximum is cited rather than independently rechecked.
- #4239 counts joint first-pivot guards for orthogonal rank-one requests. This pivoted construction has no overlapping joint-density number or shared child invoice to compare.

## CI notes

Local metadata, both registered commands, direct normal/optimized replay, committed-byte/source-history preflight, committed-export integrity, Git-free replay and declared-source corruption controls pass. Hosted CI is green on exact head `27f1ce44126cb3a841756834649f556de0ce00e9`: [run 39488429736](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39488429736), `plan` passed in 3m12s and the package `replay` passed in 1m34s. The hosted log contains both scientific PASS reports and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`; every reported package/input hash matches the committed bytes. No check failed and no check remains pending.

## Merge danger

Reversible isolated research package. Its blast radius is the new directory; production sources, old credits and selected-frontier data are unchanged.
